summary: Kandal M Venture Ltd (registrant) filed a Form 6-K reporting a securities purchase agreement with an institutional investor for the private placement of up to $25M in senior unsecured convertible promissory notes. At the initial closing on June 5, 2026, the company issued $1M in notes bearing 10% annual interest, convertible at 105% of principal, maturing in three years. Conversion is subject to a 9.99% beneficial ownership limitation. Revere Securities LLC served as exclusive placement agent for a 5% fee. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special-situation event; watch for subsequent closings and dilution from conversions.
